hypothesis: A bounded process gate can record that the Phase-3 Codex execution roadmap has no dependency-satisfied autonomous OPEN unit after M3242, and can escalate the missing PI/new-route decision before validation ranking promotion driver-performance current-sim high-fidelity full-driver repair-success robustness-result feasibility-proof paper or self-ID claim.

parent_objective: continue the ordered Phase-3 Codex execution roadmap without inventing non-admitted work
derived_from: roadmap status lines show B1b/B2b DONE and C1/C2/C3 BLOCKED
blocked_by: PI has not reopened C1 with a nonlocal-interface pricing route
no new independent preregistered pricing unit is registered
C2 remains blocked on C1 and C3 remains blocked on C2 plus PI CP-2
supersedes: continuing autonomous bookkeeping milestones after the roadmap queue is exhausted
invalidates: opening Track C extension or C2 from B1b/B2b negative pricing
running training from the current blocked roadmap state

public_gates: M3243 must not execute training, evaluation, rollout, or driver mutation
M3243 must name the blocked branch and blocked milestone in docs/escalations/
M3243 must leave next_task null unless PI registers or reopens a runnable unit
M3243 must not convert negative B1b/B2b pricing into an admission claim
forbidden_shortcuts: do not invoke train_ppo, supervised training, PPO, guarded RL, or rollout measurement
do not register a replacement work unit without PI/new-route evidence
do not admit Track C extension, C2, validation ranking, promotion, driver-performance, high-fidelity sufficiency, paper, repair-success, robustness-result, feasibility-proof, or self-ID claims

workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: Process escalation only; no measurement, validation ranking, promotion, driver-performance, current-sim result, high-fidelity result, paper claim, repair-success, robustness-result, feasibility-proof, or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop autonomous execution while no dependency-satisfied OPEN unit exists
stop if a proposed next unit lacks PI/new-route admission
stop if a proposed next unit targets a certified dead end without new pricing
fallback_plan: wait for PI to reopen C1 with a concrete nonlocal-interface pricing route
wait for PI to register a new independent preregistered pricing unit
resume only through the roadmap and harness after the dependency is resolved
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M3242 closed B2b negative and left no dependency-satisfied autonomous OPEN unit

next_stage_criteria: PI reopens C1 with a concrete nonlocal-interface pricing route

experiments/research_status.json counts the blocked row and keeps next_task null

next_blocker: PI/new-route decision required before autonomous execution can resume.
